stages.discovery: Deep wheel-ruts veer off the trail ahead. A merchant cart lies overturned in the bracken, one wheel still spinning, goods scattered through the grass.

choices.label: Follow the Tracks
choices.description: Press deeper down the trail of wreckage

choices.label: Search the Wreckage First
choices.description: A quick look before moving on
choices.outcome: You find a handful of coins spilled in the grass, but nothing else worth carrying. The trail of ruts leads on.

choices.label: Ignore
choices.description: ESC also cancels - leave it be

stages.ignore: You leave the wrecked cart to the crows and continue on your way, choosing not to follow whoever did this.

stages.discovery: Smoke curls above the tree line ahead. A rough camp sits in a hollow off the trail hide tents, stacked crates, sharpened stakes driven into the earth. Harsh, unfamiliar voices carry on the wind.

choices.label: Creep Closer
choices.description: Get near enough to see what's happening

choices.label: Circle the Camp First
choices.description: Get a look at what you're walking into
choices.outcome: Keeping to the tree line, you count several armed shapes moving between the tents — and, kneeling near the fire, bound figures who don't look like they belong to this camp at all.

choices.label: Ignore
choices.description: ESC also cancels - turn back now

stages.ignore: You back away from the camp and let it be. Whatever happened to the wagon isn't your fight — not today.

stages.discovery: The trail opens into the hollow. Bandits lounge around a cookfire while bound merchants kneel nearby under guard — the same traders whose cart you passed, broken, on the road behind you.
stages.sneak_success: Keeping low behind the crates, you watch the bandits pick over their captives' belongings, none the wiser to your approach. You'll have the first move.
stages.sneak_fail: A dry branch snaps beneath your foot. Every bandit in the camp turns toward you, weapons already drawn.
stages.ignore: You turn away as the bound merchants plead for help. Their desperate voices soon fade into the distance.

choices.label: Investigate
choices.description: Walk in and confront them openly

choices.label: Sneak Around
choices.description: Try to get the drop on them

victim_data.dialogue: Please... they'll kill us if nobody helps!
thanks: You saved our lives. We owe you everything.
after: We don't have much left, but please accept this as our thanks.

aftermath.discovery: The surviving merchants gather what remains of their caravan, tending to the wounded and counting their losses.

choices.label: Escort the Caravan
choices.description: See them safely back to Northfield
choices.outcome: You escort the battered caravan back to Northfield without further incident. The grateful merchants spread word of your bravery, and pool together a modest reward.

choices.label: Help Recover Supplies
choices.outcome: You spend some time gathering scattered goods and repairing what you can. The merchants thank you before continuing their journey.

choices.label: Leave
choices.outcome: With the danger gone, you leave the merchants to sort through the wreckage on their own.
